Name: More Hairstyles
Author: speremint
Description:
[b][size=4]THERE IS NOW A FASHION SENSE CONVERSION MOD AVAILABLE THANKS TO PERSEIDIPITY![/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24770/][size=4] [Link here][/size][/url][/b]



Thanks so much for the endorsements, they're very much appreciated and encouraged! <3


[b][size=5]Do not repost/edit/use my mod as a base without my permission![/size][/b]

So this mod just adds in new hairstyles and lightens the base game hairs (meaning that they will be more vibrant).

I will be adding in more hairstyles, so if anyone has any suggestions, please let me know. This is my first mod, so please be patient with me if I can't answer all of the questions; decided to make this available to all because I figured that I should try to give back to the modding community for once, haha [img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img]:) 


Let me know if there are any bugs, and if you guys like this mod!

[b]Installation instructions:[/b]

[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer
[*]Replace the hairstyles.xml file with the provided
[/list]
You might want to make a backup file of 'Farmer' just in case! But it should work.

------------------

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Some of the hats change the hairstyles: This is not something I can fix, that is unfortunately in the game's coding
[*]Some hairstyle numbers are bald: this is just the way the png file is set up; they are bald because I've not created hairstyles for those specific numbers yet
[/list]
